Donate & Support

Invest in California's Heritage

Your support makes it possible to restore, preserve and share the story of the Lava Cap Gold Mine with generations to come.

Where Your Donation Goes

Every contribution makes a difference

Lava Cap Historical Landmark is a 501(c)(3) non-profit. Your gift supports preservation, education and community. EIN and tax-deductibility statement

Make a Donation
$25Provides digital copies of mine maps
$100Funds one hour of professional historic preservation work
$500Restores a section of original mine structure or equipment
$1,000Provides restoration of original historical Lava Cap mine maps
$5,000Names a restored exhibit or structure in your honor

Give Your Time

Volunteer with us

Not in a position to give financially? Your time is just as valuable. We rely on volunteers for tours, events, preservation work and outreach.
